value.rationale: A full classification across all chain–order interpolation polytopes for arbitrary finite posets and arbitrary partition, with a sharp integer affine invariant and complete optimizer-locus affine dimension and uniqueness criterion. It captures invariance even when facet numbers differ or the endpoint polytopes are not affinely equivalent. The longest-chain coverage governing free center coordinates is a motivated structural phenomenon, not a narrow arbitrary example.
